newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Rate on 91-day Cyprus t-bill down at 5.43 pct.
newsitem.headline: Rate on 91-day Cyprus t-bill down at 5.43 pct.

text.p: The Central Bank of Cyprus on Wednesday sold 38 million pounds ($73.3 million) worth of 91-day treasury bills at an average yield of 5.43 percent, down from 5.49 percent at the previous auction on July 2.
The bills have a July 9 issue date.
The central bank said it recieved competitive bids totalling 48 million pounds, and accepted bids worth 38 million pounds.
Yields ranged from 5.50 percent to 5.40 percent, the bank said in a statement. ($=0.518 pounds)
